name: witself-agent-email-pilot-edge
description: Isolated Cloudflare Email Worker for the capability-limited Witself receive pilot

scripts.deploy: node scripts/render-wrangler.mjs && npm run assert:custom-domain-dark && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.generated.jsonc && npm run assert:custom-domain-dark
scripts.secret:put: node scripts/render-wrangler.mjs && wrangler secret put RELAY_ED25519_PRIVATE_KEY --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
scripts.secret:put:control-plane: node scripts/render-wrangler.mjs && wrangler secret put CONTROL_PLANE_EDGE_TOKEN --config wrangler.generated.jsonc
